hypothesis: The actual independently pinned two-stage JEPA-style candidate has only linear encoder and linear predictor, so every trained prediction is exactly equivalent to a single 2x3 direct linear transformation. Its original public linear pilot cannot identify nonlinear action-conditioned causal associations beyond an equally informed direct linear learner.

cohorts.ood_probes: 128 independent fixed-seed public float triples within source public range ±10
cohorts.train_labels_or_other_view: only paired public other_view, not private world formula

methods.two_stage: exact owner PairedViewJEPA.fit(epochs=170,lr=.025), frozen initial source weights, no changes
methods.direct_normal_equations: independent full-rank 2x3 least-squares direct linear map from identical public training pairs, no hidden formulas, no post-fit eval adjustments

observations: JEPA and direct linear compose exactly, y_i=sum_j P_ij*(sum_k E_jk*x_k). Test trained output parity on source-heldout and independent probes; calculate public heldout MSE for all comparators.
frozen_success_rule: Source/tree/blob custody PASS and max_absolute_parity_gap <= 5e-12 and direct-least-squares heldout MSE <= JEPA heldout MSE +1e-10, with deterministic model weights under exact repeated training.
frozen_failure_rule: If source drifts, linear parity fails, normal equations singular, or other controls invalid, classify ENGINEERING_INVALID, not scientific failure.
frozen_interpretation: Even PASS is a capability ceiling (function class equivalence), not a model gain or causal learning proof. A nonlinear representational substrate change, separately owned/qualified, would be required before testing unknown nonlinear causal-law transfer.
conventional_prior: All methods see same fixed train pairs and action coordinate; independent OLS is an exact fully trained linear control. Gradient path and number of parameters differ; no whole-process compute parity asserted.
fences: No protected science or original first-use
